content.comment_body: Hello, I have a question about updating [product_name]. I created a project in [version_no] and used both the operating hours counter and the annual time switch functions. According to the release notes for [version_no], these blocks have been improved. Do I just need to open and save my project in the new version, or should I replace those blocks with updated ones? Alternatively, is this update linked directly to the device firmware, meaning I need the latest firmware ([version_no])? Thank you for clarifying.
I believe you need both the updated [product_name] ([version_no]) and the firmware update to [version_no].
Thank you for your reply. Do you think simply saving the project in the new version will be enough, or should the blocks be replaced as well?
I think saving the project in the new version should be sufficient.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are trying to understand how updates to [product_name] and its firmware affect ongoing projects, especially regarding improvements to specific function blocks. They are uncertain if updates are automatically applied when saving projects in the new software version, or if manual changes are required. This indicates a need for more explicit guidance from [company_name] regarding update procedures and documentation clarity.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect clear instructions from [company_name] on whether enhanced function block features are applied automatically when saving projects with the latest version of [product_name], or if manual replacement of blocks or firmware updates are necessary.
